dataPolicy.title: Data policies
dataPolicy.definition: Definition JSON (optional; all data visible by default)

members.title: Members
members.seedSuccess: Created analyst1 / member1 / external1 and added them to the matching member groups
members.seedHint: Creates three demo accounts in the current project and adds them to the analyst / member / external groups. Existing accounts with the same name keep their current password.

subjectGrant.title: Dashboard access · {{name}}
subjectGrant.hint: Check to grant view access. Granting a folder covers every dashboard inside it, including ones created later. Assets with edit access are read-only here.
subjectGrant.empty: No folders or dashboards to grant

groups.title: Member groups
groups.membersHint: Only people who are already members of this project can be added. Groups cannot be bound to the owner.

roles.title: Roles
roles.ownerNotice: Each project has at most one owner, assigned only by a platform super admin. Analysis admins cannot change this definition.
roles.readonlyHint: Preset roles cannot be customized. Only the project owner can change the analysis admin definition.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.hintLead: External AI and automation tools can use
apiKeys.hintTail: to run read-only ClickHouse queries. Create one in a single click with "New API key" (auto-named, project scope defaults to clklogapp, never expires). The plaintext key is shown only once at creation, so store it somewhere safe.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? It stops working immediately
apiKeys.deleteConfirm: Delete this key? This cannot be undone
apiKeys.plaintextWarning: This key is shown only once. After you close this dialog the plaintext cannot be viewed again, so save it now.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.ownerNotice: Each project has exactly one owner. Only a platform super admin can create projects and assign or replace the owner; the previous owner is downgraded to analysis admin. Creating a project only registers the analysis space name — no ClickHouse database is created.
projectSettings.nameHint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, 2–63 characters. The project_name reported by the SDK must match.
projectSettings.displayNamePlaceholder: Human-readable name; can be the same as the project name
projectSettings.accountCreated: Account created; add it to a project under Members
projectSettings.accountHint: Creates the sign-in identity only — it does not automatically become a member of any project. Add people to a project under Members.

grant.subjectTypeInvalid: subject_type must be user or group

asset.editGrantAnalystGroupOnly: Edit grants can only be given to member groups with the analyst role
asset.editGrantAnalystOnly: Edit grants can only be given to analysts of this project
asset.viewGrantDashboardOnly: View grants apply to dashboards and folders only
asset.withdrawGrantBeforeLock: Withdraw the edit grant before locking
